---
title: "Pricing Non-Pecuniary Harm: A Jurimetric Analysis of Moral Damages Awards in Brazilian Appellate Courts"
author:
  - name: "Valber Gregory"
    affiliations: "Independent researcher"
date: today
abstract: |
  [Draft skeleton — no results yet. To be written after phase 1.]
  Brazilian law leaves the monetary valuation of moral damages to judicial discretion,
  bounded only by "reasonableness and proportionality" and the STJ's two-stage method.
  Using the full text of appellate decisions of the Court of Justice of the Federal
  District (TJDFT, 2015–2025) obtained through its public API, we extract the awarded
  amounts and estimate the distribution of awards by type of harm, the share of variance
  attributable to judges and panels, the compression effect of appellate review, the
  response of awards to binding STJ precedents, and the role of anchors and inflation.
keywords: [moral damages, jurimetrics, judicial discretion, quantile regression, multilevel models, Brazil]
